decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in therear elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Reduction in size of two unauthorised dormer windows and retention of one x two bed self-contained flat
